verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains extensive product/docs detail but no mention of pricing, plans, free tier, trial limits, or cost at all — only that the platform repo is source-available under FSL-1.1-ALv2 with an Apache-2.0 catalog, which speaks to self-hosting licensing, not a hosted free tier for prototyping. Pricing plans are a fair axis for a SaaS integration platform, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
